system.description:
The Grandmother of Witches, older than any coven that claims her, older than most of the borders on any map of Arneyan. Her hut walks on chicken legs somewhere out past the edge of settled land, and it finds the Witches it wants to find — not the other way around.

  • Patron Buff (1st): Once per day, grant a touched creature (or yourself) advantage on all Wisdom and Intelligence-based checks for one hour — Baba Yaga's wisdom lends itself, briefly, to those she favours. They also have Advantage on their next Will save within the hour.
  • Patron Curse (3rd): Once per day, set a creature within 30ft an impossible task as a curse (Will save negates) — on a failed save they immediately suffer disadvantage on all Charisma checks until they attempt the task in good faith (for up to 1 day per Witch level), as if the world itself is waiting on them to finish.
  • Physical Change (7th): Your teeth sharpen slightly and one lock of your hair turns iron-grey no matter your true age.
  • Advantage on Survival checks in deep wilderness, and you always know which direction leads to the nearest dwelling, however far.
  • You may make an unarmed bite attack dealing 1d6 damage.
  • Once per day as a reaction when struck in melee, the ancient magic in your blood answers unbidden — the attacker makes a Will save or suffers disadvantage on their next attack roll.
